unbanked_dlln_entries.embedded_english: They've got a damn halftrack up there!

entries.embedded_english: They're coming from every direction!
They're in the church grounds now. Hold them back!
Jerryies down there!
Sharpe, get on the back lad.
Good to see you, boys!
Can't believe you came for us.
No problem, lads. Where's Captain Morgan?
He's back there, sir.
He's taken a bullet in his leg though, Sarge.
Sharpe!  Plant the charge!
Through the door!
Sharpe! What you waiting for.  Get over here!
Fine work, Sergeant.  My thanks to you and your men. I'll make sure Command hear of this…
Just doing our bit, sir.  Just doing our bit...
That was bloody close!
Damn it, sorry sir - I lost control on that bend
We'll discuss the technicalities later Taylor! Get us out of here!
Sharpe, keep us covered lad.
The wheel's are just spinning. It's stuck!
TAYLOR! Get us bloody moving!!
Bloody hell! Nice driving, Taylor.
So, the Captain’s holed up at the church, pinned down, and we’re going in to get them out, right?
That’s about the size of it, Taylor.
Hah, you reckon we’ll get medals?
<laughs> Knowing the Captain, we’ll be lucky to get a handshake, lad.
There’s the church spire behind those buildings…
Road looks clear...
Germans down the hill!
BOOM!... Hah, have that, Jerry!
Taylor, they've blocked the road. You'll have to go cross-terrain.
Taylor, you berk!  Get off the road!
Go straight through the fenc,e Taylor!
Hold on to your hats, boys!
Crikey it's a Panzer.
Sharpe, Sharpe!....get up
Let's move….Go Go!
They're coming from the South now Sharpe.  Have at 'em lad!
It's not far…c'mon!
Captain…Sergeant Maddock's here.
Glad you could make it, sergeant.
So am I, sir. What's the situation?
Jerry got lucky and caught me with a blasted bullet, sergeant
Can you walk?
Unfortunately not.
We can't hold out forever up here, sir.  Not with so many Germans still in the town.
Understood, Sergeant.  Just make sure you get the men out of here.
Sir, there's no way me and the lads are leaving you behind.  If you an't walk, then I'll find us some transport.
There's two jeeps round the back, but by the looks of them, they've had it.
Sir….they were knackered! There's no way we can drive 'em.
I was a mechanic back in civvie life, sir.  I bet I could have 'em going in  a jiffy.
Glad to know you're good for something, Taylor.  Get on it, lad!
If we can just hold Jerry back until they come back we might just have as hot at this Sergeant Maddock.
Understood sir. Sharpe keep your eyes peeled and shoot anything not in a british uniform!
Up there, Sarge.   The church…
Looks like our boys are in trouble up there.
Here they come! Get down…
Step on it, Sharpe.  Get down that street and knock out the half-track.
C’mon, Sharpe, we’ve gotta flank that bloody half-track or those lads down there are in for it.
Taylor, get that door open!
Okay, Sarge.
Sharpe - earn your King's shilling, lad.  Give us some supporting fire.
Taylor, get a charge on that bridge.
ALRIGHT, LADS - WE'RE LEAVING!
Down there. Across that bridge
Damn.  That's a Panzer!  Get in cover!
Step on it, Taylor!
Righto!
Sharpe, get on that MG
Counter attack!
Nicely done lads. Let’s get through here. Taylor! – the door please.
Sharpe, Taylor - get across the street and bung a charge on that half-track.
Okay, Sarge.  C’mon, Sharpe - let's get to it.
Damn it, they’ve got us pinned.
We need air support, now!
I'm on it, sir.
Did someone order a taxi?
You wait ages for one and two come along at once eh?
Hell!  Jerries have mined the road!
Arrrgh!
Most of the roads are blocked with debris.  We’ll have to pick our way through to the church.
Jerries, everywhere!
Keep moving!   We can handle 'em.
Stone me, they've got armour down there now.
